core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
name: Exogenous antigen processing and MHC class II presentation
rationale: All members concern loading, presentation or regulation of peptide antigen on MHC class II; unlike the regulation/loading-only confusable it also covers the processing of exogenous antigen (including in germinal center B cells), and unlike the others it is MHC class II peptide rather than MHC class I cross-presentation or lipid/MHC Ib presentation.

name: MHC class II peptide loading and its regulation
rationale: All members concern assembly of peptide with MHC class II and the (including negative) regulation of that presentation, plus antigen-presentation modules; it lacks the exogenous antigen processing and germinal center B cell members of its closest confusable and the monocyte, lipid and TLR7/8 content of the others.
